title: Metric
description: A formally defined, reusable semantic specification that describes a measurable property, characteristic, condition, quantity, rate, ratio, index, or other observable aspect of a subject, including the semantic rules necessary to determine and interpret its value. A Metric is foundational: reified across the measurement-dimension orthogonal allocator (ADR-0002 D1) and referenceable from any OpenDEAM profile. (CR-MET-001 binding CR-MET-000 reconciliation and ADR-MET-001.)

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

subject_concept.description: The type of phenomenon or property measured (CR-MET-001 binding). Normative: required, distinguishes a Metric by what it measures rather than by its MECE label.

measurement_nature.description: The data nature of the value produced by applying this Metric. Normative: required. CR-MET-001 binding.

directionality.description: Desired interpretation of increasing or decreasing values. CR-MET-001 binding.

calculation_definition.description: Formula or computational definition. Required when measurement_nature is numeric and the value is computed; for ordinal/nominal/boolean values a textual rule suffices.

unit.description: Measurement unit (cross-reference to the unit registry per CR-MET-005). Optional: required only when measurement_nature is numeric. Examples: %, count, days, USD, ms.

measurement_method.description: How this metric is collected or calculated.

scope_layers.description: Architecture layers this metric may evaluate (OpenDEAM v0.2.0 measurement-dimension scope).

legacy_metric_type.description: DEPRECATED. The pre-CR-MET-001 MECE taxonomy value. Preserved for one release cycle to allow migration of existing catalog records. New records MUST use the binding six-axis classification per CR-MET-002 / ADR-MET-003.
